about.heading: About
about.bio: I'm a final-year B.Tech CSE (Data Science) student at NIIT University, building end-to-end AI and ML systems rather than notebooks — an agentic RAG pipeline that audits insurance bills clause-by-clause with zero fabricated citations, a Kubernetes autoscaler that forecasts traffic and beats the stock autoscaler by 62% (and honestly reports where it didn't), and a customer analytics pipeline that turns raw transactions into ranked retention decisions. I care most about systems that measure their own claims instead of asserting them.

projects.name: Bill Auditor
bullets: Audits hospital bills against insurance policy documents line-by-line, citing the exact clause behind every deduction
Zero fabricated clause citations across all recorded evaluation versions
Hybrid dense + lexical retrieval (ChromaDB + BM25) with cross-encoder reranking over a 399-clause index
LLM never performs arithmetic — all money math runs in Python, keeping every figure verifiable
Evaluation harness scores 328 bill lines against a hand-written answer key; accuracy threshold gates CI and blocks regressions
492 unit tests across an 8-stage Jenkins pipeline, deployed to Kubernetes

images.alt: Benchmark overview reporting 62% lower p99 latency against the stock autoscaler
Benchmark replay view with a scrubber for stepping through a run second-by-second

projects.name: Predictive Autoscaling for Kubernetes
bullets: Built an autoscaler that forecasts traffic 60 seconds ahead and adds pods before the load arrives, instead of after
Cut p99 latency 62% (479 → 183 ms) vs default Kubernetes autoscaling, measured across 15 A/B runs on identical traffic
Forecast request rate with a LightGBM quantile model on 39 features, tuned to over-predict since running short costs 10x more
Fixed a 40% slowdown on traffic spikes by raising the HPA's floor instead of setting pods directly — 49% better than HPA alone
Added safety checks that rejected 22% of 975 scaling decisions where the forecast wasn't trustworthy

projects.name: Customer Segmentation & Retention
bullets: Processes 540K+ raw transactions into 391K validated records across 4,334 customers
Crosses BG/NBD + Gamma-Gamma lifetime value with XGBoost churn risk (0.78 ROC-AUC) into an action matrix
Flagged 229 high-value, high-risk customers worth £16.5K in predicted 90-day revenue
RFM features with K-Means segments give each customer a readable label, not an opaque score
MLflow experiment tracking and DVC data versioning, served via FastAPI backend and React dashboard
